arguments.body:
Managers,

A reminder from the February 2024 leadership reset: “more room, same discipline”—a defensible story, not a bigger one. The raise created more operating room; it did not make Mercury suddenly enterprise-ready or justify expanding scope by default.

Did the raise authorize reopening every deferred Mercury enterprise item? No. We agreed to keep the enterprise-readiness work bounded and sequenced, and not treat financing as permission to reopen every deferred initiative. A reminder from the February 2024 leadership reset: “more room, same discipline”—a defensible story, not a bigger one. The raise created more operating room; it did not make Mercury suddenly enterprise-ready or justify expanding scope by default.
